dataset.title: New York Stock Exchange (S&P 500 prices and fundamentals)
dataset.upstream_source: Prices from Yahoo Finance; fundamentals from annual SEC 10-K filings (per the description)
dataset.adjustment: prices.csv raw; prices-split-adjusted.csv split-adjusted only (no dividends)
dataset.timestamps: Trade date; fundamentals carry period end only (no filing date)
dataset.use_restrictions: Research and education; Yahoo-derived prices may not be redistributed commercially.
known_limitations: Constituent list is a 2016 snapshot (survivorship bias)
Fundamentals have no filing/acceptance date, so they are NOT used in point-in-time signals
Used for cross-source validation, split detection and sector labels (GICS)
